title: MV I just wanna talk about my game a little and my overall experience with RPG maker MV + Community

posts.author: PoopsyTheDuck
posts.body:
For starters, the forums here are really nice. Usually I expect toxic behavior online in forums so this is refreshing.
Second, I don't want to just spam helpless doom and gloom when asking questions about my game in it's alpha stage.
Third, I'm mainly an artist, not a game developer, so the fact I have such a fun time making a game in RPG Maker MV adds a lot to me and actually made me want to learn Javascript, as hard for me as it is.
In addition, I got something to show you!
My first ever tileset!
It's for a graveyard.
Also I got a safe-ish sprite to show y
Maxim the lovely! He is a giant character, the main character is Luna though but I can't show her cuz she's one of the reasons why the game is r18.
Spoiler:
Warning! Not for the easily disturbed.
